title: Traffic Psychology
summary: Traffic psychology: driver behavior, risk perception, fatigue, attention, road safety, and accident prevention.
objectives: Explain road safety and accident prevention.
revision: Traffic psychology: driver behavior, risk perception, fatigue, attention, road safety, accident prevention.
traps: Traffic psychology = driver behavior and road user psychology.

notes.t: The study of driver behavior, road user psychology, and psychological factors in traffic safety and accident prevention.

i: Driver attention: focusing on driving task
Risk perception: judging danger on road
Distraction reduction: minimizing phone and other distractions
Safe following distance: adequate space between vehicles

notes.t: UGC NET may ask about driver behavior, risk perception, and road safety.

mnemonics.title: DFRR
mnemonics.text: D — Driver attention (focus on road), F — Fatigue (tiredness reduces alertness), R — Risk perception (judging danger), R — Road safety (prevention)

flashcards.a: Driver behavior and road user psychology.
